question: What is the purpose of the Cross-Match test or cross-test in solid organ transplantation ?:

options.opa: To detect the presence in the donor of antibodies against the histocompatibility antigens of the graft recipient.
options.opb: To check the correct typing of the alleles of loci A, B and DR.
options.opc: To detect the presence in the receptor of antibodies against minor antigens of histocompatibility of the receptor itself. (autoantibodies).
options.opd: To detect the presence in the recipient of antibodies against the histocompatibility antigens of the donor.
